facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tobj:HSD_TObjAlloc
facts.value: Performs one class-based construction attempt. A non-NULL result follows the normal return path, while a NULL result enters the assertion path before the function can return normally; the allocator itself does not mutate texture-object subsystem state beyond creating the new instance.
facts.reason: Construction can execute selected-class callbacks; no foreign class-constructor review establishes the claim of no further subsystem side effects.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tobj:HSD_TObjAnim
facts.value: A NULL HSD_TObj is an immediate no-op. Otherwise the attached AObj governs playback: an absent or stopped AObj is ignored; first play evaluates without frame advancement; ordinary steps advance by framerate; looping playback rewinds or clamps at its end frame; `AOBJ_NO_UPDATE` suppresses texture-property writes; and completed non-looping playback transitions to `AOBJ_NO_ANIM`.
facts.reason: AOBJ_NO_UPDATE only replaces the ordinary interpreter callback with NULL. Loop and terminal StopAnimAll calls still receive update_func; the blanket suppression claim needs FObj stop-path review.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/tobj:TObjInfoInit
facts.value: At runtime, the routine transitions hsdTObj into configured class metadata: the common initializer marks it initialized, ensures the hsdObj parent is initialized, copies the parent's inheritable dispatch region, and registers hsdTObj beneath that parent; TObjInfoInit then overrides the inherited slots with TObj lifecycle and texture-operation callbacks.
facts.reason: Exact parent registration/copy/init semantics belong to foreign class internals, not the local callback installation body.
